_notes.name: The name at the top of the poster.
_notes.birthdate: The day the grid starts, written YYYY-MM-DD.
_notes.years: How many rows the grid has, one per year of age. 90 by default; any whole number from 40 to 120.
_notes.eras: Three to eight stretches of life, each a tinted band with its label in the left margin. from and to are YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD; to may be "now" for an era still going. color is the band's color, written like "#5E8C6A".
_notes.events: Single dates to flag, each a marked week with its label in the right margin. date is YYYY-MM-DD; a date still to come is marked too.
_notes.quote: The line printed under the grid. Put a name after " — " to credit it. Use "" for none.
_notes.paper: The printed poster's size: A2, A3, A4, or Letter.
_notes.theme: paper (bone white, lived weeks in ink), ink (black, lived weeks in bone), or auto (paper by day, ink when the device is set to dark).

name: Ines Halvorsen
